name: taube-markdown-tool
description: Markdown annotations, block drag and a text toolbar; defers mind maps to personal-mindmap.

scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node scripts/verify-bundle.mjs
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.test: node --test tests/enhancements.test.cjs tests/mindmap.test.cjs tests/personal-mindmap-compat.test.cjs tests/selection-tools.test.cjs tests/annotation-anchor.test.cjs tests/legacy-migration.test.cjs tests/block-drag.test.cjs tests/markdown-toolbar.test.cjs tests/history-session.test.cjs
scripts.test:ui: node tests/ui-test.cjs && node tests/selection-ui-test.cjs && node tests/mindmap-ui.cjs && node tests/drag-ui.cjs && node tests/toolbar-ui.cjs

author: taube
